comment: Accepted known failures of tests/python/fuzz/fuzz.py. Each entry names a ledger id that is OPEN in tests/python/regress/manifest.json and a predicate on the case record (see README.md). A record that matches is tagged with the id and does not fail --strict; an entry whose ledger id is no longer open makes --strict exit 2 (remove the entry when the bug is fixed). Only open ledger bugs belong here; new findings do not.

accepted.name: tr_fold_vectors_short
accepted.why: time reversal merges k with -k but tag.tr_folded stays false, so multiplet() cannot build the conjugate partner and vectors() returns fewer than min(k, dim) vectors (cluster C01-pyapi-01)

accepted.name: tr_fold_expect
accepted.why: expect() of a TR-odd or non-real observable ignores the conjugate partner of a TR-merged star (cluster C01-pyapi-01)

accepted.name: tr_fold_thermal_observables
accepted.why: thermal <O>(T) of a TR-odd or non-real observable ignores the conjugate partner of a TR-merged star (cluster C01-pyapi-01)

accepted.name: flip_require_total_spin
accepted.why: spin_flip='require' raises 'the subspace is not flip-invariant' under total_spin S > 0 although H is flip-symmetric

message.re: spin_flip='require' but the subspace is not flip-invariant

accepted.name: flip_require_fixed_sz
accepted.why: spin_flip='require' raises 'the subspace is not flip-invariant' for an explicit sz (n_up != N/2) although H is flip-symmetric

message.re: spin_flip='require' but the subspace is not flip-invariant

accepted.name: flip_require_parity_odd_n
accepted.why: spin_flip='require' with sz='even'/'odd' and odd N: each half maps to the other under the flip, so every sector is a mirror-1 n_up != N/2 subspace and the engine refuses (the same engine_options downgrade gap)

message.re: spin_flip='require' but the subspace is not flip-invariant

accepted.name: total_spin_noninvariant_observable
accepted.why: under total_spin, expect() and thermal(observables=) refuse a non-SU(2)-invariant operator instead of returning its multiplet / thermal average

message.re: with a total-spin restriction every (operator|observable) must be

accepted.name: total_spin_tower_count
accepted.why: FTLM / mTPQ tower sampling under total_spin matches the Sz = S and Sz = S + 1 blocks by engine irrep index; with a point group whose co-group collapses in one sector the multiplet count is wrong and thermal raises

message.re: thermal: (the blocks hold [0-9]+ spin-[0-9]+/2 multiplets, expected [0-9]+|a block is larger at Sz = S \+ 1 than at Sz = S)

accepted.name: gpu_w_block_parity_or_full_space
accepted.why: parity / full-space runs put every point-group star through the isotypic W path, which has no device kernel; device='gpu' refuses the block

message.re: n_up -1 \(dim [0-9]+\) is an isotypic \(W\) block, which has no device kernel

accepted.name: gpu_w_block_fixed_n_up
accepted.why: at fixed n_up a star with irreps of dimension > 1 (or a declined group path) goes to the isotypic W path, which has no device kernel (the K1-sym-composition-02 claim); P6.3 retires the W path (d-dimensional group sectors) for every n_up, which removes these too

message.re: n_up [0-9]+ \(dim [0-9]+\) is an isotypic \(W\) block, which has no device kernel
